name: vizier
description: Deterministic authorization checks for agent actions.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vizier/sdk && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit
